recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被多形性浸潤取代，許多中型細胞胞質透明（clear cells），其間穿插大量分枝狀的細長血管（arborizing high endothelial venules），這種血管增生加上透明細胞是血管免疫母細胞 T 細胞淋巴瘤（AITL）的線索。
features: Effaced lymph node architecture without residual follicles in this field
Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes and medium-sized cells with clear cytoplasm
Prominent arborizing, slender branching vessels (high endothelial venules) throughout
Scattered eosinophilic cells/histiocytes and interstitial pink material
No sheets of large cells or granulomas at this magnification
describe_en: Section of lymph node at medium power shows diffuse effacement by a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes admixed with numerous medium-sized cells with clear cytoplasm. There is prominent proliferation of arborizing high endothelial venules traversing the infiltrate, with scattered histiocytes and eosinophilic cells. No residual reactive follicles are seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (nodal TFH-cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type); confirmation requires TFH markers (PD-1, CD10, BCL6, CXCL13), CD21 for expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks, and T-cell clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia preserves sinuses and follicles, lacks clusters of clear atypical cells, and shows no aberrant TFH phenotype or clonal TCR.
PTCL-NOS lacks the prominent arborizing HEVs, expanded FDC meshworks and consistent TFH marker expression.
cHL contains CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background without clear-cell T-cell clusters.
